levels.name: No branding target
levels.description: Brand Manager cannot resolve a scenario or readable source tree to assess branding.
entry_criteria: Scenario name or path is provided
exit_criteria: The target scenario resolves to a readable tree

levels.name: Branding scan available
levels.description: The provider can scan the target and return normalized branding findings for Test Genie and agents.
exit_criteria: Branding scan completes with structured findings and summary counts

levels.name: Brand identity declared
levels.description: The scenario declares a non-placeholder brand display name — the minimum identity every surface renders.
exit_criteria: No missing display-name finding blocks branding identity

levels.name: Visual system defined
levels.description: The scenario defines a core color system and typography so its surfaces share one coherent look.
exit_criteria: No missing color-system or typography finding blocks the visual system

levels.name: Brand assets present
levels.description: The scenario ships real brand imagery (logo, favicon, valid non-template assets) users and tabs actually see.
exit_criteria: No missing/invalid logo, favicon, or template-residue finding blocks brand assets

levels.name: Accessible and applied
levels.description: Core (light + dark) color pairings meet WCAG AA and the brand is actually applied (markers + manifest keys) — fleet-ready branding.
exit_criteria: No contrast (light/dark) or unapplied-markers finding blocks fleet-ready branding

levels.name: Installable and shareable
levels.description: The scenario is an installable, consistently-branded PWA: complete manifest (icons 192/512 + maskable), theme-color + color-scheme, mobile status-bar safe-area handling, social/link-preview metadata, and a name that agrees across every surface.
exit_criteria: No PWA/manifest, theme-color, safe-area, social-metadata, cross-surface consistency, or CLI/API branding finding blocks installability

has-display-name.reason: A meaningful display name requires human/product judgment, not a deterministic default.

has-color-system.reason: A complete baseline token set is only created when none exists; an existing-but-incomplete file is left to a human (not advertised as auto-fixable).

has-typography.reason: Font selection is a design choice, not a deterministic default.

has-logo.reason: Logo image generation is non-deterministic and requires AI or a human asset.

has-favicon.reason: Self-contained: derived from an existing logo. When no logo exists it is honestly guidance-only (autofix not advertised).

no-template-residue.reason: Default Vite favicon/title residue is removed deterministically; lorem-ipsum copy stays a manual finding.

asset-validity.reason: Flattening/re-encoding an icon or generating an icon set is an image transform left to the brand-projection path.

referenced-assets-exist.reason: A dangling reference is fixed by shipping the missing image bytes, which cannot be synthesized deterministically.

svg-asset-safety.reason: Stripping nodes from a hand/tool-authored SVG can silently break its rendering, so sanitizing stays a human decision.

custom-font-loaded.reason: Fetching/self-hosting a typeface is not a deterministic edit; font selection is a design choice.

reduced-motion-support.reason: A uniform prefers-reduced-motion reduce block is appended to the existing design tokens; when no tokens file exists it is guidance-only.

wcag-aa-contrast.reason: Re-balancing a palette to pass AA requires design judgment, not a mechanical edit.

dark-mode-contrast.reason: Re-balancing the dark palette to pass AA requires design judgment.

brand-markers-applied.reason: Applying markers is brand-projection: it needs an assigned brand via the apply domain, which the served validation path has no input for, so it is guidance-only here.

theme-color-present.reason: The missing-entirely case is auto-injected; deriving a dark-scheme variant value is left guidance-only.

ios-statusbar-safe-area.reason: Injects viewport-fit=cover + a safe-area-inset token deterministically; the runtime render is out of scope (ui-health/device harness).

manifest-completeness.reason: Scalar fields are filled from identity + house defaults; missing icons require a logo and stay guidance-only.

cli-branding.reason: Human-facing CLI help copy is a writing decision, not a deterministic default.

api-branding.reason: The API/OpenAPI title (service.description) is human-authored product copy.
